Venue: Hibt
Headline: Hibt Event Contracts Challenge — Trade to Climb the Leaderboard, Invite Friends to Earn More Points!

ANNOUNCEMENT / RULES:
Dear Hibtizens,
The Hibt Event Contracts Challenge is here, featuring two exciting competition tracks! Trade and invite friends to compete for a share of the 10,000 USDT prize pool.
## 1. Event Period
Registration Opens: 2026-11-18, 16:00 (UTC)
Competition Period: 2026-11-19, 16:01 – 2026-11-27, 15:59 (UTC)
## 2. Eligibility
- Have a Futures Account on Hibt with a balance of at least 5 USDT.
- Trade Event Contracts using a genuine Hibt account.
- Event Contracts trading volume and referral counts will only be tracked after registration is completed.
## 3. Prize Pool and Competition Tracks
## Track 1: Trading Volume Leaderboard
## Prize Pool: 3,600 USDT
## Ranking Rules
- Rankings are based on cumulative Event Contracts trading volume during the event period.
- Both profitable and unprofitable trades count, provided they are genuinely executed.
- Participants are ranked by trading volume in descending order.
## Trading Volume Leaderboard Rewards
Rank | Futures Bonus (USDT)
1st Place | 1,000
2nd Place | 700
3rd Place | 500
4th–10th Place | 200 each
## Track 2: Referral Leaderboard
## Prize Pool: 6,400 USDT
Ranking Rules: Users earn points by completing the tasks. Rankings and rewards are determined by the total points earned.
## Points Rules
- Invite friends to register on Hibt. If a referred user completes at least 50 USDT in Event Contracts trading volume during the event period, they count as one qualified referral, earning the inviter 1 point.
- For every additional 1,000 USDT in Event Contracts trading volume completed by each qualified referral, the inviter earns 1 additional point. The inviter's own trading volume does not count toward these points.
Example: User A registers for the event and refers 3 new users by the end of the event. If these 3 qualified referrals generate a combined Event Contracts trading volume of 5,000 USDT, User A earns 8 points.
## Referral Leaderboard Rewards
Rank | Futures Bonus (USDT)
1st Place | 1,200
2nd Place | 800
3rd Place | 600
4th–10th Place | 300 each
11th–20th Place | 170 each
## Additional Referral Rewards
The top 20 winners on the Referral Leaderboard will also receive:
- 30 USDT Profit Boost Voucher
- 20 USDT Transferable Event Prediction Voucher
## 4. Reward Distribution
- All rewards will be distributed within 5 business days after the event ends.
- Futures Bonus cannot be withdrawn directly, but profits generated from trading with the bonus can be withdrawn.
- Rewards from both competition tracks can be combined.
## 5. Important Notes
- Each user may participate with only one account.
- All Event Contracts trades are automatically counted toward both leaderboards.
- Leaderboards are updated daily. Final rankings are determined at the end of the event.
- No rewards will be issued for abnormal trading or wash trading.
- Hibt reserves the right of final interpretation of this event.
